description: Passive buff that multiplies outgoing damage. Applied after base damage calculation in BuffBleed and BuffSkillValue pipelines. Supports flat percentage bonus, HP-loss scaling, and fixed-HP-loss scaling.

param1.description: Calculation type (0-2). Determines how the damage multiplier is computed.

param2.description: Activation filter. 0 = always active. 1 = only active for skills in _skillList.

param5.description: Array of skill IDs. If _activeType == 1, buff only applies to these skills.

skillPar: Base multiplier coefficient for damage scaling

type_1.name: HP Loss Scaling (Current HP)
type_1.formula: hpLostRatio = round((maxHp - currentHp) / maxHp); finalDamage = round(damage * (1 + hpLostRatio * skillPar))
type_1.description: More damage the more HP the owner has lost. Uses actual current HP.

type_2.name: HP Loss Scaling (Fixed HP via CURRENT_HP buff)
type_2.formula: fixedHp = currentHp; if CURRENT_HP buff exists: fixedHp = round(CURRENT_HP.getFixHp() * maxHp); hpLostRatio = round((maxHp - fixedHp) / maxHp); finalDamage = round(damage * (1 + hpLostRatio * skillPar))
type_2.description: Same as type 1 but uses the CURRENT_HP buff's fixed HP value instead of actual current HP. Allows decoupled HP tracking.
